_readme: AGENT-ADDABLE powerups, two halves: (1) ICONS — every PNG in assets/sprites/items/powerups/ automatically becomes a map powerup item (drop a new PNG, it shows up, zero code/data edits); (2) EFFECTS — each spawned item rolls a random effect from this weighted pool and shows its popup text on pickup. weight = explicit odds (compliance). effect types are code-backed (flagged exception): heart_restore, damage_boost, speed_boost, succ (shawarma vacuum), invincibility, freeze, goon_nova.
